name: solera-map
description: Mindmap-style visual layer for Solera projects — Service / Plan / Build / Live canvases over the same .solera/ data.

soleraMap.command.description: Shell command that launches the solera-map server. Invoked in the workspace folder. Default assumes `uv` is on PATH and the solera-map Python package is resolvable.

soleraMap.port.description: Local HTTP port the spawned server binds to (also used by the webview to talk to it).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run copy-viewer && npm run compile
scripts.copy-viewer: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.resolve('../solera-map/viewer/dist');const dst=path.resolve('media/viewer');fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});function cp(s,d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name),dp=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(dp,{recursive:true});cp(sp,dp);}else{fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp);}}}cp(src,dst);console.log('Copied viewer dist to media/viewer/');"
